scenes.title: Forty Yellow Lemons
scenes.summary: Friday morning arrives, Rocio walks steadily on her rested ankle, and Clara and Tomas help squeeze forty fresh lemons for opening night.

scenes.title: Hook Number Nine
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Mateo screws a ninth brass hook onto the wooden key board and hangs the polished Room 9 key in its permanent home.

scenes.title: Twenty-Four Chairs After All
scenes.summary: At 5:45 PM, neighbours start streaming through the open gate early, proving Ernesto's accidental twenty-four-chair order was exactly what they needed.

scenes.title: Sold Out in Fifteen Minutes
scenes.summary: Rocio, Clara, and Tomas race happily between kitchen and courtyard as nearly every slice of lemon tart sells out in fifteen minutes.

scenes.title: Courtyard Waltz Complete
scenes.summary: Inside the glowing glass sunroom, Carmen introduces the completed thirty-year-old waltz and plays it to warm applause from the whole courtyard.

scenes.title: A Table Every Friday
scenes.summary: Under the lanterns, Javier tells Tomas and Rocio he has rented a ground-floor design studio on their street so he can move back to the city and share a Friday table with Tomas every week.

scenes.title: Staying On
scenes.summary: As the last neighbours head home, Carmen asks Clara and Mateo if she can stay another fortnight in Room 4 and play every Friday evening.

scenes.title: Under the Third Stone
scenes.summary: Closing the front desk for the night, Clara, Mateo, and Ernesto read a 30th-anniversary May postcard mailed from abroad asking if the old tin capsule is still buried under the third stone from the courtyard tree.
